design_note: A 50% retaliatory wound on every one of four cheap 1-life bodies can quietly out-trade the squad's own cost, making the threshold swing worth more than the base statline.

name: Swampbrood Lurkers (variant)
ability_1_desc: When a Swampbrood Lurker you control is destroyed by an adjacent opponent's figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the figure that destroyed that Swampbrood Lurker receives 1 wound. Marro figures are never affected by Toxic Barbs.
ability_2_desc: Swampbrood Lurkers may move through all water spaces and swamp water spaces without stopping, and they never roll for swamp water damage.
ability_3_desc: When a Swampbrood Lurker you control is defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure and it is adjacent to another Swampbrood Lurker you control, it rolls 1 additional defense die.
design_note: At 20% the barbs are mostly flavor, so the squad must be priced almost entirely as a vanilla A3 D2 melee common with water tricks.

name: Vector Sentinel
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with this Vector Sentinel, you may choose another Soulborg you control within 10 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, place this Vector Sentinel on any empty space adjacent to that Soulborg. If you roll a 7 or lower, this Vector Sentinel cannot move or attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one other figure within 3 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Suppression Volley Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Soulborg figures adjacent to this Vector Sentinel add 1 to their Range value when attacking a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: Reliable repositioning plus a whiff clause creates a high-variance tempo engine whose value depends heavily on whether the relay lands often enough to be an every-turn plan.

name: Vector Sentinel (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving normally with this Vector Sentinel, you may choose another Soulborg you control within 10 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, place this Vector Sentinel on any empty space adjacent to that Soulborg. If you roll a 14 or lower, this Vector Sentinel cannot move or attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: Range 6. Attack 2. Choose a figure to attack. You may also choose one other figure within 3 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure to be affected by Suppression Volley Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: All friendly Soulborg figures adjacent to this Vector Sentinel add 1 to their Range value when attacking a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: With only a 30% chance the relay is a trap that wastes whole turns, so the drawback clause may actually make the power a net negative rather than a discount.

name: Whisperwind Longbows
ability_1_desc: After a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a non-adjacent figure with a normal attack and that figure receives no wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: When a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a figure whose base is at least 3 levels below its base, it adds 1 to its Attack value.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Whisperwind Longbows, you may first take a turn with any Elf Wizard you control.
design_note: A 50% consolation wound on every missed shot effectively raises a 3-die volley's damage floor across three figures, which compounds far past what a single-figure d20 power would be worth.

name: Whisperwind Longbows (variant)
ability_1_desc: After a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a non-adjacent figure with a normal attack and that figure receives no wounds, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: When a Whisperwind Longbow you control attacks a figure whose base is at least 3 levels below its base, it adds 1 to its Attack value.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Whisperwind Longbows, you may first take a turn with any Elf Wizard you control.
design_note: At 20% the miss-conversion barely moves expected damage, leaving bonding and range 6 to carry the price even though the card text looks nearly identical to its twin.

name: Ashera Vaunt
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Ashera Vaunt, you may choose Ashera Vaunt or any Human or Kyrie figure you control within 3 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from the chosen figure's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: All Unique Heroes you control who follow Jandar add 1 to their Defense Value while adjacent to Ashera Vaunt.
design_note: A near-coinflip repeatable heal on a sturdy 5-life melee hero is hard to separate from her defensive aura's value to a Jandar hero build.

name: Ashera Vaunt (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with Ashera Vaunt, you may choose Ashera Vaunt or any Human or Kyrie figure you control within 3 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, remove 1 Wound Marker from the chosen figure's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: All Unique Heroes you control who follow Jandar add 1 to their Defense Value while adjacent to Ashera Vaunt.
design_note: The heal now succeeds only 30% of the time, so almost all of the card's price must come from its solid base stats and aura.

name: Fenmarsh Stingers
ability_1_desc: If a Fenmarsh Stinger you control inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's figure with a normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure cannot move on its next turn. Paralyzing Venom does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Fenmarsh Stingers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces, and add 1 to their Defense Value while on a water or swamp space.
design_note: Move-denial on a 50% roll is a soft form of control that is easy to undervalue on an otherwise weak range-5 attack-2 squad.

name: Fenmarsh Stingers (variant)
ability_1_desc: If a Fenmarsh Stinger you control inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's figure with a normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure cannot move on its next turn. Paralyzing Venom does not affect destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: Fenmarsh Stingers do not have to stop their movement when entering water spaces, and add 1 to their Defense Value while on a water or swamp space.
design_note: At a 20% success rate the venom becomes an occasional bonus rather than a plan, leaving a plain 3-figure ranged chaff squad.

name: Vantiel Lancers
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking normally with the Vantiel Lancers, you may move each Vantiel Lancer you control up to 7 spaces. Vantiel Lancers may move through all opponent's Small and Medium figures during this movement and are never attacked when leaving an engagement. For each opponent's Small or Medium figure a Vantiel Lancer moves through, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. A Vantiel Lancer may not end its movement on an occupied space.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Vantiel Lancers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Hero you control who follows Einar.
design_note: Bonding plus a movement-based multi-hit special attack on a 3-figure unique squad stacks two high-variance value sources on top of one another.

name: Vantiel Lancers (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking normally with the Vantiel Lancers, you may move each Vantiel Lancer you control up to 7 spaces. Vantiel Lancers may move through all opponent's Small and Medium figures during this movement and are never attacked when leaving an engagement. For each opponent's Small or Medium figure a Vantiel Lancer moves through, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. A Vantiel Lancer may not end its movement on an occupied space.
ability_2_desc: Before taking a turn with the Vantiel Lancers, you may first take a turn with any Unique Hero you control who follows Einar.
design_note: With only a 20% wound chance the charge is mostly a repositioning and disengage tool, so the bonding carries the card.

name: Kharn-Class Enforcer
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Kharn-Class Enforcer, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that Kharn-Class Enforcer. Targeting Overload may be used only once per turn per Kharn-Class Enforcer.
ability_2_desc: A Kharn-Class Enforcer adds 1 to its Defense Value when defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: A 65% chance at a second range-6 attack pushes a 1-life common hero toward squad-level output while remaining trivially killable.

name: Kharn-Class Enforcer (variant)
ability_1_desc: After attacking with a Kharn-Class Enforcer, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may attack one additional time with that Kharn-Class Enforcer. Targeting Overload may be used only once per turn per Kharn-Class Enforcer.
ability_2_desc: A Kharn-Class Enforcer adds 1 to its Defense Value when defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
design_note: Dropping the extra attack to 30% turns a potential ranged powerhouse into a cheap fragile sniper, testing how steeply the threshold is discounted.

name: Brother Calder Emberhand
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking with Brother Calder Emberhand, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or higher, you may remove up to 2 Wound Markers from any one Unique Hero you control within 5 clear sight spaces of Brother Calder Emberhand. If you roll a 7 or lower, you may remove 1 Wound Marker from Brother Calder Emberhand's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack for any figure you control who follows Jandar and is adjacent to Brother Calder Emberhand, add 1 die to the defense roll.
design_note: A reliable two-wound heal on any Unique Hero is worth far more per turn than his mediocre combat stats, and the consolation self-heal means the power never truly whiffs.

name: Brother Calder Emberhand (variant)
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking with Brother Calder Emberhand, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, you may remove up to 2 Wound Markers from any one Unique Hero you control within 5 clear sight spaces of Brother Calder Emberhand. If you roll a 14 or lower, you may remove 1 Wound Marker from Brother Calder Emberhand's Army Card.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dike against a normal attack for any figure you control who follows Jandar and is adjacent to Brother Calder Emberhand, add 1 die to the defense roll.
design_note: At only a 30% success rate the healer spends most order markers doing nothing but patching himself, so nearly all of the card's value collapses onto the defensive aura.

name: Skarn Bogbiters
ability_1_desc: After a Skarn Bogbiter attacks a figure with a normal attack and that figure is not destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1 or a 2, destroy the attacking Skarn Bogbiter. Venom Spurs has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: A Skarn Bogbiter does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.
design_note: A 50% chance of a free extra wound on every surviving target roughly converts a 3-attack melee squad into a 4-attack squad, but the 10% self-destruct clause claws back some of that value.

name: Skarn Bogbiters (variant)
ability_1_desc: After a Skarn Bogbiter attacks a figure with a normal attack and that figure is not destroyed, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the defending figure receives 1 wound. If you roll a 1 or a 2, destroy the attacking Skarn Bogbiter. Venom Spurs has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: A Skarn Bogbiter does not have to stop its movement when entering a water space.
design_note: With success at only 20% the risk of destroying your own figure on a 1 or 2 becomes almost as likely as the payoff, making the signature power close to point-neutral.

name: Thalos Windriders
ability_1_desc: Once per turn, before attacking with a Thalos Windrider, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the figure attacked by that Thalos Windrider may roll no more than 1 die for defense against that attack.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Thalos Windrider's movement, ignore elevations. A Thalos Windrider may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Thalos Windrider starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Range 6, attack 3, flying and a coin-flip armor-strip on a high-defense target pushes a three-figure unique squad toward the top of the ranged-squad band.

name: Thalos Windriders (variant)
ability_1_desc: Once per turn, before attacking with a Thalos Windrider, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the figure attacked by that Thalos Windrider may roll no more than 1 die for defense against that attack.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for a Thalos Windrider's movement, ignore elevations. A Thalos Windrider may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Thalos Windrider starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A 20% armor-strip once per turn is a rare bonus rather than a plan, so this card must be priced almost entirely off flying range-6 attack-3 statlines.

name: Deconstructor Prime
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Deconstructor Prime, you may roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to this Deconstructor Prime. If you roll a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Pulse Discharge has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: When this Deconstructor Prime attacks a destructible object, add 3 dice to its attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for this Deconstructor Prime against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: An uncommon hero that can field multiples makes the swarm-punishing pulse scale with the number of adjacent figures, so even a 30% threshold can snowball against squads.

name: Deconstructor Prime (variant)
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Deconstructor Prime, you may roll the 20-sided die once for each figure adjacent to this Deconstructor Prime. If you roll an 8 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Pulse Discharge has no effect on destructible objects.
ability_2_desc: When this Deconstructor Prime attacks a destructible object, add 3 dice to its attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for this Deconstructor Prime against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: At 65% per adjacent figure the pulse becomes a near-automatic multi-wound area attack before a 4-die swing, which is hard to price without over-rewarding an uncommon hero that can be taken in bulk.

name: Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker
ability_1_desc: After moving with Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker, instead of attacking, you may choose one adjacent Small, Medium, or Large figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the chosen figure is destroyed. If you roll a 16 or lower, the chosen figure receives 1 wound. Figures affected by Mountainbreaker Slam cannot roll defense dice.
ability_2_desc: When Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker attacks an adjacent figure whose base is at least 3 levels below Vorgrimm's base, add 2 dice to Vorgrimm's attack.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Vorgrimm the Mountainbreaker's movement, Vorgrimm may move up or down 4 levels of elevation for 1 space of movement. Vorgrimm never rolls for falling damage.
design_note: A 25% chance to auto-destroy any non-Huge figure is swingy and could be worth far more than the 1-wound consolation, so the slam's true value depends heavily on how often a Move 4 Huge hero reaches an adjacent target.

name: Bastion-7
ability_1_desc: All Soulborgs you control that are adjacent to Bastion-7 add 2 dice to their defense when rolling defense against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure.
ability_2_desc: When Bastion-7 rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure and blocks all of the skulls rolled, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: Bastion-7 may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph. Bastion-7 never rolls for falling damage, and is never affected by any special power that would prevent it from moving.
design_note: Defense 7 with a punish-on-clean-block power makes Bastion-7 nearly unkillable by melee squads while contributing almost nothing offensively, so its worth swings wildly depending on whether the opposing army has range.

name: Grovetender Oakthane
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Choose up to 3 figures adjacent to this Grovetender Oakthane. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with this Grovetender Oakthane, if it did not move during that turn, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Grovetender Oakthane's Army Card.
ability_3_desc: When this Grovetender Oakthane is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, choose 3 spaces in a straight line from the space this Grovetender Oakthane occupied. All figures on those spaces receive 1 wound.
design_note: Self-healing that requires standing still fights directly against a 3-target melee area attack, so the card's effective output depends on which power the player gives up each turn.

name: Skarn Coldmaw
ability_1_desc: After attacking with Skarn Coldmaw's normal attack, if a Small or Medium figure was destroyed by that attack, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure that occupy a water space are also affected by Tidal Surge Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: Skarn Coldmaw may move through water spaces without stopping, and ignores all Water special powers on Army Cards and Glyphs. If Skarn Coldmaw begins its turn on a water space, add 1 die to Skarn Coldmaw's normal attack for that turn.
design_note: Eleven life plus repeated healing off squad kills gives near-limitless staying power, but the area attack and attack bonus are worthless on maps without water, making the price extremely terrain dependent.

name: Hurgrim the Pillar
ability_1_desc: On any turn you take with this Hurgrim the Pillar, you may either move with it or attack with it, but not both.
ability_2_desc: All Soldiers you control that are adjacent to this Hurgrim the Pillar add 1 die to their defense when rolling defense against a normal attack.
ability_3_desc: Any opponent's Small, Medium, or Large figure that moves adjacent to this Hurgrim the Pillar must immediately end its movement. This Hurgrim the Pillar may not be moved by any special power on an Army Card or Glyph.
design_note: Defense 8 and a movement-stopping zone of control are premium wall traits, but Ponderous means it can almost never threaten anything, so the drawback may cancel most of the defensive premium.

name: Sir Gauthar the Unyielding
ability_1_desc: When an opponent's figure targets a friendly Small or Medium figure adjacent to Sir Gauthar the Unyielding for a normal attack, you may choose Sir Gauthar as the target of that attack instead. Sir Gauthar rolls his own defense dice against that attack. Sir Gauthar may not be chosen with Bulwark of Jandar more than once per attacking figure's turn.
ability_2_desc: If Sir Gauthar the Unyielding receives one or more wounds from a normal attack and is not destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: All Knights you control, except Sir Gauthar the Unyielding, add 1 die to their defense when rolling defense against a normal attack from an adjacent figure.
design_note: Redirecting enemy attacks onto a Defense 6 body is a powerful squad-protection engine whose value scales with the number of cheap Knights alongside him, making him nearly unpriceable in isolation.

name: Grokthar the Unbound
ability_1_desc: When moving with this Grokthar the Unbound, it may move through spaces occupied by Small or Medium figures without becoming engaged, but it may not end its movement on an occupied space. For each figure this Grokthar moves through, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures affected by Trampling Charge cannot roll defense dice.
ability_2_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this Grokthar the Unbound and before taking its turn, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 4 or lower, your opponent takes this Grokthar's turn this turn instead of you.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, this Grokthar the Unbound subtracts 2 dice.
design_note: Twelve life with Attack 6 and free squad-shredding movement would be a top-tier beater, but a 20% chance of handing the turn to the opponent and a crippling penalty against ranged fire pull its value in opposite directions.

name: Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion
ability_1_desc: At the end of each round, for each opponent's figure adjacent to Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: Each time one or more figures are destroyed by Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion's normal attack, place 1 bone marker on this Army Card. Nharr-Zhek adds 1 die to his defense for each bone marker on this Army Card, to a maximum of 3 additional dice.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Nharr-Zhek the Bone Bastion, you may first take a turn with one Undead Squad you control.
design_note: Bonding on a Defense 6 Huge body that grows to Defense 9 while passively wounding everything next to it stacks three separate premium effects, so small pricing errors compound badly.

name: Aegis Prime
ability_1_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to Aegis Prime roll 1 additional defense die when defending against a normal attack.
ability_2_desc: Aegis Prime is never affected by an opponent's special powers that would move him from the space he occupies, and he is never affected by knockback or trample special powers. Aegis Prime never rolls for falling damage.
ability_3_desc: When Aegis Prime rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, each excess shield counts as an unblockable hit on the attacking figure, to a maximum of 2 hits.
design_note: A pure immobile wall with no ranged or special attack, whose value comes almost entirely from a stacking defensive aura that only pays off in a crowded line.

name: Morvath the Grinding Doom
ability_1_desc: At any point while moving, Morvath may choose a Small or Medium figure that is adjacent, on the same level, and on a space where Morvath may end his movement. Roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 1-7, the chosen figure is unaffected and Morvath must end his movement. If you roll 8 or higher, the chosen figure receives 1 wound, and you may place that figure on any empty space adjacent to the space it occupied. Morvath may then continue moving.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. All figures adjacent to Morvath are affected by Rubble Sweep Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: When Morvath attacks a destructible object, or a figure whose Life number is 7 or higher, he rolls 2 additional attack dice.
design_note: Stacking a repeatable trample, a full area special attack, and a conditional +2 attack on an already enormous attack 6 chassis makes the offensive ceiling hard to separate from dragon-tier pricing.

name: Thal-Mora the Tidewall
ability_1_desc: Thal-Mora does not have to stop her movement when entering water spaces. While Thal-Mora occupies a water space, she rolls 1 additional defense die against all attacks.
ability_2_desc: An opponent's figure must end its movement when it moves into a space adjacent to Thal-Mora. Figures with Flying are not affected by Grasping Coils.
ability_3_desc: Range 2. Attack 3. After attacking with Undertow Special Attack, if the defending figure was not destroyed, you may place that figure on any empty space adjacent to Thal-Mora that is on the same level or lower than the space it occupied.
design_note: A zone-lock power that stops enemy movement is worth far more on certain maps than others, so its board-control value is almost impossible to average into a flat cost.

name: Bramblewrought Elder
ability_1_desc: If this Bramblewrought Elder moves 1 or more spaces on its turn, it cannot attack during that turn.
ability_2_desc: Range 2. Attack 4. This Bramblewrought Elder may only use Thornlash Special Attack if it did not move on this turn. Figures attacked by Thornlash Special Attack that are adjacent to a tree or bush roll 1 fewer defense die.
ability_3_desc: At the end of a round, if this Bramblewrought Elder is adjacent to a tree or bush and did not move during that round, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
design_note: A severe cannot-move-and-attack drawback is paired with self-healing and terrain-dependent bonus dice, so the card is either a cheap immobile turret or a strong anchor depending entirely on the map's foliage.

name: Cinderplate Juggernaut
ability_1_desc: Once per round, instead of moving and attacking with Cinderplate Juggernaut, you may choose a figure within 8 clear sight spaces of Cinderplate Juggernaut and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 16 or higher, the chosen figure and each figure adjacent to the chosen figure receives 2 wounds. If you roll 1-15, Cinderplate Juggernaut receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: When Cinderplate Juggernaut rolls defense dice against a Special Attack, he rolls 2 additional defense dice.
ability_3_desc: Cinderplate Juggernaut does not have to stop his movement when entering rubble, snow, or lava field spaces, and he never rolls for lava field damage.
design_note: A 25% chance of dealing 2 unblockable wounds to a whole cluster is swingy and self-damaging, so the power's expected value badly understates its game-deciding upside.

name: Quarry Brute
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. A Quarry Brute may only use Heave Boulder Special Attack if it did not move on this turn. Figures attacked by Heave Boulder Special Attack must be on the same level as, or lower than, the attacking Quarry Brute.
ability_2_desc: You may not reveal more than one Order Marker on this Army Card each round. If a second Order Marker is revealed on this card during a round, it is discarded and no turn is taken.
ability_3_desc: When a Quarry Brute rolls defense dice against a Special Attack, it rolls 1 additional defense die.
design_note: Common-hero pricing expects cheap stats, but life 7 defense 5 with a ranged special attack is elite for the slot, and the one-order-marker restriction is the only thing holding it down.

name: Colossus of Vespidor
ability_1_desc: After moving and before attacking with the Colossus of Vespidor, roll the 20-sided die once for each opponent's figure adjacent to the Colossus. If you roll 14 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: All friendly figures that follow Einar and are within 4 clear sight spaces of the Colossus of Vespidor roll 1 additional attack die when attacking destructible objects or Huge figures.
ability_3_desc: The Colossus of Vespidor is never affected by an opponent's special powers that would destroy it without rolling attack dice, and it never receives more than 3 wounds from any single attack or special power.
design_note: Damage caps and immunity to instant-destruction powers are defenses against specific enemy cards rather than average dice, making the effective survivability wildly matchup dependent.

name: Xul'Gath the Devouring Mound
ability_1_desc: Instead of attacking, you may choose a Small or Medium figure adjacent to this Xul'Gath and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll 17 or higher, destroy the chosen figure and you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. If you roll 1-16, the chosen figure receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with this Xul'Gath, roll the 20-sided die once for each opponent's figure adjacent to this Xul'Gath. If you roll 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Soulborgs and Marro are not affected by Corrosive Mass.
ability_3_desc: This Xul'Gath does not have to stop its movement when entering water or swamp water spaces, and it is never affected by molten lava or swamp special powers.
design_note: Defense 7 with a self-healing instant-destroy gate means the card can grind forever against melee squads yet does almost nothing against ranged armies, splitting its fair price in two.

name: Thagmar Ironjowl
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking normally with Thagmar Ironjowl, you may move him up to 4 spaces. Thagmar may move through spaces occupied by opponent's Small or Medium figures, but he may not end his movement on an occupied space. For each opponent's figure whose space Thagmar moves through, roll 3 attack dice. The affected figure rolls defense dice normally. Thagmar never takes leaving engagement attacks during a Crushing Advance.
ability_2_desc: After moving with Thagmar Ironjowl and before attacking, you may choose one adjacent Small or Medium figure and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound and cannot move until the end of the round. If you roll a 1-12, Thagmar cannot attack this turn.
ability_3_desc: Thagmar Ironjowl is never affected by an opponent's special power that would move him, place him, or destroy him without rolling attack dice.
design_note: A move-4 bruiser whose trample can hit several figures for free but costs his entire attack, so its real value swings wildly with enemy army composition.

name: Vault Sentinel
ability_1_desc: A Vault Sentinel cannot move and attack on the same turn. If a Vault Sentinel moves at least one space on its turn, it cannot attack this turn.
ability_2_desc: All friendly figures adjacent to a Vault Sentinel you control roll 1 additional defense die when defending against a normal attack.
ability_3_desc: A Vault Sentinel is never affected by an opponent's special power that would move it or place it on another space. A Vault Sentinel cannot be carried and does not fall when a supporting figure is destroyed.
design_note: Defense 8 on a cheap Common Hero looks unbreakable, but never moving and attacking on the same turn makes it nearly harmless offensively.

name: Vaskoria the Ruinjaw
ability_1_desc: Instead of moving and attacking with Vaskoria the Ruinjaw, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, each figure within 3 clear sight spaces of Vaskoria receives 2 wounds, and all destructible objects within 3 clear sight spaces of Vaskoria are destroyed. If you roll a 1-15, Vaskoria receives 1 wound. Figures you control are affected by Cataclysmic Maw.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Vaskoria the Ruinjaw are affected by Tail Sweep Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: When Vaskoria the Ruinjaw rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure and rolls at least 3 shields, the attacking figure receives 1 wound.
design_note: A 25% chance of a battlefield-clearing area blast that also wounds your own troops and Vaskoria on a miss makes the swingy d20 gate hard to price.

name: Gorlomm the Mirewall
ability_1_desc: When an opponent's figure moves into a space adjacent to Gorlomm the Mirewall, that figure must end its movement there. Opponent's figures can never move through spaces adjacent to Gorlomm.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if Gorlomm the Mirewall occupies at least one water space, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Gorlomm the Mirewall does not have to stop his movement when entering water spaces, and he never rolls for molten lava or other hazardous terrain damage on swamp water spaces.
design_note: Ten life and a total zone-of-control lock make him a devastating chokepoint holder, yet with only Range 1 and Move 4 he can be ignored entirely on open maps.

name: Bulwark Engine ARC-9
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. Bulwark Engine ARC-9 may use Siege Mortar Special Attack only if it did not move this turn. Choose a space within 6 clear sight spaces of ARC-9. The figure on that space and all figures adjacent to that space are affected by Siege Mortar Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: If Bulwark Engine ARC-9 did not move on its turn, add 2 to its Defense Value until the start of your next turn.
ability_3_desc: Bulwark Engine ARC-9 never rolls fewer than 3 defense dice against a special attack, and it is never affected by a special power that would lower its Defense Value.
design_note: It is either a Defense-9 immobile artillery piece or a Move-4 melee figure with no ranged option, and which mode the opponent allows determines nearly all of its worth.

name: Archon Solvyn
ability_1_desc: When a friendly figure adjacent to Archon Solvyn would receive one or more wounds from a normal attack, you may have Archon Solvyn receive those wounds instead. Archon Solvyn does not roll defense dice for wounds received this way.
ability_2_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this card and before taking a turn with Archon Solvyn, you may choose up to 2 friendly Small or Medium figures within 5 clear sight spaces of Archon Solvyn and move each of them up to 3 spaces. Figures moved this way do not take leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Archon Solvyn's movement, ignore elevations. Archon Solvyn may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Archon Solvyn is engaged when he starts to fly, he will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Damage soaking plus free repositioning of allies is strong support, but the wound transfer has no defense roll and can delete him quickly in the wrong matchup.

name: Thornhulk of Gravenwood
ability_1_desc: If this Thornhulk of Gravenwood did not move on its turn, add 2 to its Defense Value until the start of your next turn and it rolls 1 additional attack die when attacking this turn.
ability_2_desc: Any opponent's figure that begins its turn adjacent to this Thornhulk of Gravenwood subtracts 2 from its Move Value this turn. Opponent's figures adjacent to this Thornhulk cannot use special powers that ignore elevations to leave engagement.
ability_3_desc: After revealing an Order Marker on this card, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card. If you do, this Thornhulk of Gravenwood cannot move this turn.
design_note: An Uncommon Hero that can be fielded in multiples and heals itself every turn it stands still, making its effective durability much higher than its printed life.

name: Mortenbrall the Gravebound
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 6. Mortenbrall the Gravebound may use Mausoleum Smash Special Attack only if he did not move this turn. If the defending figure is destroyed by Mausoleum Smash Special Attack, all figures adjacent to that figure receive 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: After an opponent's figure is destroyed within 4 clear sight spaces of Mortenbrall the Gravebound, you may remove 1 wound marker from this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Before taking a turn with Mortenbrall the Gravebound, you must roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, Mortenbrall cannot move this turn and must attack the nearest figure within range, even a figure you control.
design_note: Passive healing off every enemy death offsets his mediocre defense, while a 15% chance of losing control each turn punishes committing order markers to him.

name: Blighted Husk
ability_1_desc: Blighted Husks do not start the game on the battlefield. When a Marro Stinger Drone you control is destroyed, before removing that figure from the battlefield, you may place a Blighted Husk on that space. You may never have more Blighted Husk figures on the battlefield than the number of Marro Stinger Drone figures you started the game with.
ability_2_desc: Order Markers may not be placed on this Army Card. When you reveal an Order Marker on the Marro Stinger Drone Army Card, before or after taking a turn with a Marro Stinger Drone, you may also take a turn with one Blighted Husk you control.
ability_3_desc: When a Blighted Husk is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, each figure adjacent to that Blighted Husk receives 1 wound. Blighted Husks are never affected by Burst of Spores.
design_note: It is an unlimited-but-conditional stream of free 2-life bodies that costs no order markers of its own, so its value depends entirely on how many base drones the buyer already fields.

name: Sister Aelys Ascendant
ability_1_desc: Sister Aelys Ascendant does not start the game on the battlefield. Before taking a turn with Sister Aelys of the Dawn, if there are 2 or more wound markers on her Army Card, you may remove Sister Aelys of the Dawn from the battlefield and place Sister Aelys Ascendant on that space. Transfer all wound markers to this Army Card, then remove 2 of those wound markers. For the remainder of the game, Order Markers on the Sister Aelys of the Dawn Army Card are used to take turns with Sister Aelys Ascendant.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Small and Medium figures adjacent to Sister Aelys Ascendant add 1 to their Defense Value.
ability_3_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. If the defending figure is Undead, roll 2 additional attack dice. Figures attacked with Radiant Smite Special Attack may not use any special power that would ignore or negate wounds.
ability_4_desc: When counting spaces for Sister Aelys Ascendant's movement, ignore elevations. She may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When she starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: The swap only triggers after the base hero is already damaged, so the buyer pays up front for a strong aura hero that may never reach the battlefield.

name: Gorehound Unleashed
ability_1_desc: Gorehounds Unleashed do not start the game on the battlefield. Before taking a turn with a Bloodmaw Gorehound, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to remove that Bloodmaw Gorehound from the battlefield and place a Gorehound Unleashed on that space. Transfer all wound markers from the Bloodmaw Gorehound Army Card that belonged to that figure onto this Army Card. Take that turn with the Gorehound Unleashed.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with a Gorehound Unleashed, if it destroyed one or more figures this turn, you may immediately take another turn with that same Gorehound Unleashed. You may not use Blood Frenzy more than once each round.
ability_3_desc: When you take a turn with a Gorehound Unleashed, it must move as many spaces as possible toward the nearest enemy figure it can reach, and if it is engaged at the end of its movement, it must attack an adjacent enemy figure.
ability_4_desc: A Gorehound Unleashed may move up to 3 spaces through spaces occupied by other Beast figures you control.
design_note: Move 8 with a chained extra turn is explosive, but defense 1, forced targeting, and the one-order-marker cost of the swap pull hard in the other direction.

name: Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol
ability_1_desc: Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol does not start the game on the battlefield. Before taking a turn with Thraxus-9, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to remove Thraxus-9 from the battlefield and place Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol on that space. Transfer all wound markers to this Army Card. If Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol cannot legally be placed on that space, you may not use Siege Protocol Deployment. For the remainder of the game, Order Markers on the Thraxus-9 Army Card are used to take turns with Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol.
ability_2_desc: Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol cannot move and attack on the same turn. Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol may never be moved by any special power, friendly or otherwise.
ability_3_desc: Range 8. Attack 3. Choose a space within 8 clear sight spaces of Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol. The figure on that space and all figures adjacent to that space are affected by Artillery Barrage Special Attack. Roll 3 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_4_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a figure that is 4 or more spaces away, Thraxus-9 Siege Protocol rolls 1 additional defense die.
design_note: Defense 5 with a range-8 area special attack reads as a premium card, but it burns the X Order Marker to arrive and can never move and shoot in the same turn.

name: Kel'Vareth Moonbound
ability_1_desc: Kel'Vareth Moonbound does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing an Order Marker on Kel'Vareth the Wildspeaker and before taking a turn with him, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, remove Kel'Vareth the Wildspeaker from the battlefield and place Kel'Vareth Moonbound on that space, transferring all wound markers to this Army Card. Take that turn with Kel'Vareth Moonbound. If you roll a 10 or lower, you must take that turn with Kel'Vareth the Wildspeaker.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if Kel'Vareth Moonbound is on the battlefield, remove him and place Kel'Vareth the Wildspeaker on that space, transferring all wound markers to the Kel'Vareth the Wildspeaker Army Card.
ability_3_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. With Rending Claws Special Attack you may attack twice, but you must choose a different figure for the second attack.
ability_4_desc: When counting spaces for Kel'Vareth Moonbound's movement, ignore elevations. Kel'Vareth Moonbound never takes leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: The form is strictly better than its base card but only arrives half the time and evaporates every round, so the add-on price hinges on a coin-flip that repeats.

name: The Drowned Choir
ability_1_desc: The Drowned Choir does not start the game on the battlefield. At the end of a round in which one or more Tidecallers of Varn figures were destroyed, you may place one Drowned Choir figure on an empty water space within 6 spaces of a destroyed Tidecaller's space for each Tidecaller destroyed this round. Order Markers on the Tidecallers of Varn Army Card are used to take turns with The Drowned Choir. You may never have more than 3 Drowned Choir figures on the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: Drowned Choir figures may pass through all figures without becoming engaged and never take leaving engagement attacks. Drowned Choir figures do not have to stop their movement when entering a water space.
ability_3_desc: Any enemy figure adjacent to two or more Drowned Choir figures subtracts 1 from its Attack Value and 1 from its Move Value.
ability_4_desc: At the end of each round, destroy any Drowned Choir figure that is not within 5 clear spaces of a water space.
design_note: Free returning squad figures are strong, but they are unplaceable on dry maps and self-destruct away from water, making the card's value swing wildly with terrain.

name: Cinderbound Husks
ability_1_desc: Cinderbound Husks do not start the game on the battlefield. When an Emberpike Levy figure you control is destroyed by an attacking figure, before removing it from the battlefield, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 9 or higher, place a Cinderbound Husk on that space instead of removing the figure. You may never have more than 4 Cinderbound Husk figures on the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: Order Markers may not be placed on this Army Card. When you reveal an Order Marker on the Emberpike Levy Army Card, you may move and attack with any Cinderbound Husks you control as though they were Emberpike Levy figures.
ability_3_desc: When a Cinderbound Husk is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, each figure adjacent to that Cinderbound Husk receives 1 wound. Cinderbound Husks and Emberpike Levy figures are never affected by Burning Collapse.
ability_4_desc: Cinderbound Husks never take wounds from molten lava spaces or lava field spaces and do not have to stop their movement when entering them.
design_note: It is a free second life for an entire common squad at a 60% rate plus a death-burst, all bought once for the whole card with no order marker cost.

name: Sarrathir, Wings of Ruin
ability_1_desc: Sarrathir, Wings of Ruin does not start the game on the battlefield. Before taking a turn with Sarrathir the Coiled, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to remove Sarrathir the Coiled from the battlefield and place Sarrathir, Wings of Ruin on that space and the unoccupied spaces needed for his base. Transfer all wound markers to this Army Card. If there is not enough room to place this figure, you may not use Draconic Metamorphosis. For the remainder of the game, Order Markers on the Sarrathir the Coiled Army Card are used to take turns with Sarrathir, Wings of Ruin.
ability_2_desc: Range Special. Attack 4. Choose 6 spaces in a straight line from Sarrathir, Wings of Ruin. All figures on those spaces who are in line of sight are affected by Cinder Wind Special Attack. Roll 4 attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_3_desc: Once per round, before moving Sarrathir, Wings of Ruin, you may choose an enemy figure within 5 clear sight spaces and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, that figure subtracts 2 from its Defense Value until the end of the round.
ability_4_desc: When counting spaces for Sarrathir's movement, ignore elevations. Sarrathir may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Sarrathir starts to fly, if he is engaged he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A full dragon's statline priced as an add-on breaks the usual 20-80 add-on band, and the Huge base makes the placement requirement a real risk of the card being dead weight.

name: Vaskarr the Rimewraith
ability_1_desc: Vaskarr the Rimewraith does not start the game on the battlefield. When Vaskarr, Frostmane Shaman is destroyed, before you remove that figure from the battlefield, you may place the Vaskarr the Rimewraith figure on the space Vaskarr, Frostmane Shaman occupied. Any Order Markers on Vaskarr, Frostmane Shaman's Army Card are immediately moved to this Army Card, keeping the same numbers. Vaskarr the Rimewraith begins with no Wound Markers on this Army Card. Once the Vaskarr the Rimewraith figure has been placed on the battlefield, Vaskarr, Frostmane Shaman cannot return to the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: Range 3. Attack 3. Choose a figure within 3 clear sight spaces of Vaskarr the Rimewraith. That figure and all figures adjacent to it are affected by Hoarfrost Nova Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure that receives at least 1 wound from Hoarfrost Nova Special Attack cannot be moved by any special power or glyph until the end of the round.
ability_3_desc: Vaskarr the Rimewraith can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement. When counting spaces for Vaskarr the Rimewraith's movement, ignore elevations.
design_note: It arrives for free the instant its base card dies with wounds wiped clean, so the add-on effectively doubles the base hero's life while upgrading every stat.

name: Sylvanna Thornmantle, Heartwood Aspect
ability_1_desc: Sylvanna Thornmantle, Heartwood Aspect does not start the game on the battlefield. Once per game, after revealing an Order Marker on Sylvanna Thornmantle, Grovewarden and instead of taking a turn with her, you may remove that figure from the battlefield and place the Heartwood Aspect figure on the space she occupied and any unoccupied adjacent space. All Order Markers on Sylvanna Thornmantle, Grovewarden's Army Card are immediately moved to this Army Card, keeping the same numbers, and the Heartwood Aspect begins with no Wound Markers on this Army Card. You may then take a turn with the Heartwood Aspect. Sylvanna Thornmantle, Grovewarden cannot return to the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: All small and medium opponent's figures that enter or occupy a space adjacent to the Heartwood Aspect may not move. Figures affected by Bramblegrasp Aura cannot be moved by any special power on an Army Card or glyph.
ability_3_desc: If the Heartwood Aspect did not move during its most recent turn, add 2 to its Defense Value and it cannot be moved by any opponent's special power or glyph.
design_note: A voluntary mid-game swap that heals all wounds and jumps to a defense 5 Large body makes the add-on a guaranteed second life rather than a conditional one.

name: Talia Voss, Fractured
ability_1_desc: Talia Voss, Fractured does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing an Order Marker on Talia Voss, Chronowright and before taking a turn with her, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, remove that figure from the battlefield and place the Talia Voss, Fractured figure on the space she occupied. Move all Order Markers on Talia Voss, Chronowright's Army Card to this Army Card, keeping the same numbers, and move all Wound Markers from that Army Card to this Army Card. You may then take a turn with Talia Voss, Fractured. If you roll a 1-10, take a turn with Talia Voss, Chronowright as normal.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Talia Voss, Fractured, you may reveal an unrevealed Order Marker on this Army Card. If you do, return that Order Marker face down to this Army Card and immediately take 1 additional turn with Talia Voss, Fractured. You may not use Rewind Special Power more than once per round.
ability_3_desc: At the end of each round, if Talia Voss, Fractured is on the battlefield, you must place 1 Wound Marker on this Army Card.
ability_4_desc: Talia Voss, Fractured can move through all figures and is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A coin-flip entry, carried-over wounds, and a self-wounding clock fight against a repeatable extra-turn engine, so the add-on's real value depends entirely on how fast the game ends.

name: Blood-Mad Kraghorn
ability_1_desc: Blood-Mad Kraghorn do not start the game on the battlefield. At the end of any round in which 2 or more Kraghorn Raiders you control were destroyed, you may place up to 2 Blood-Mad Kraghorn figures on empty spaces within 3 spaces of a Kraghorn Raider you control. If you control no Kraghorn Raiders, place them on empty spaces in your starting zone instead. You may never have more than 3 Blood-Mad Kraghorn figures on the battlefield at one time. You may place Order Markers on this Army Card even if there are no Blood-Mad Kraghorn figures on the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: Any or all Blood-Mad Kraghorn may add 3 to their Move number as long as they are unengaged prior to moving. A Blood-Mad Kraghorn must be able to move adjacent to an opponent's figure in order to use Berserker Charge.
ability_3_desc: When a Blood-Mad Kraghorn you control is destroyed by an opponent's normal attack, roll 2 attack dice. The attacking figure receives 1 wound for each skull rolled. Dying Howl cannot be used against destructible objects.
ability_4_desc: A Blood-Mad Kraghorn must move as far as possible toward the nearest opponent's figure it can reach and, if able, must attack an adjacent figure during its turn.
design_note: A squad add-on that only materializes after your base squad is already dying, with a forced-aggression drawback offsetting attack 4 on defense 1 bodies.

name: Kurosh, the Deepmaw
ability_1_desc: Kurosh, the Deepmaw does not start the game on the battlefield. At the start of any round, if Kurosh the Tidecaller occupies a water space, you may remove that figure from the battlefield and place the Kurosh, the Deepmaw figure on the space he occupied and any unoccupied adjacent spaces. Move all Order Markers on Kurosh the Tidecaller's Army Card to this Army Card, keeping the same numbers, and move all Wound Markers from that Army Card to this Army Card. Kurosh the Tidecaller cannot return to the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 4. All figures adjacent to Kurosh, the Deepmaw are affected by Engulf Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Figures on water spaces roll 1 fewer defense die against Engulf Special Attack.
ability_3_desc: If Kurosh, the Deepmaw is not on or adjacent to a water space at the start of his turn, subtract 2 from his Move Value and 1 from his Defense Value for that turn.
design_note: A Huge, 8-life, attack 6 body arriving as an add-on stretches the normal add-on ceiling, and its value swings wildly with how much water the map has.

name: The Vigil Eternal
ability_1_desc: The Vigil Eternal does not start the game on the battlefield. Each time an Oathsworn of Greystrand you control is destroyed, you may place 1 Vigil Eternal figure on the space that figure occupied, if that space is unoccupied. There are only 2 Vigil Eternal figures; once both have been placed, this power has no further effect. You may place Order Markers on this Army Card even if there are no Vigil Eternal figures on the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, a Vigil Eternal figure adds 1 die for each other Vigil Eternal figure or Oathsworn of Greystrand you control adjacent to it.
ability_3_desc: A Vigil Eternal figure cannot be moved, targeted, or destroyed by any opponent's non-attack special power, and never rolls for falling damage.
design_note: Two defense 4 unkillable-by-powers bodies trickle in only as the base squad dies, so the add-on's worth is tied to an unknown number of base-card deaths.

name: Harkanth, the Crownless
ability_1_desc: Harkanth, the Crownless does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing an Order Marker on Emperor Harkanth the Ninth, instead of taking a turn with him, you may remove that figure from the battlefield and place the Harkanth, the Crownless figure on the space he occupied. Move all Order Markers and all Wound Markers on Emperor Harkanth the Ninth's Army Card to this Army Card, keeping the same Order Marker numbers. You may then take a turn with Harkanth, the Crownless. Emperor Harkanth the Ninth cannot return to the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: When attacking with a normal attack, Harkanth, the Crownless adds 1 die to his attack for every 2 Wound Markers on this Army Card.
ability_3_desc: After taking a turn with Harkanth, the Crownless, if he is not adjacent to any figure you control, you may reveal an "X" Order Marker on this Army Card to take 1 additional turn with Harkanth, the Crownless.
ability_4_desc: Harkanth, the Crownless is never affected by friendly special powers on other Army Cards, including bonding, aura, and healing powers, and cannot be chosen as the target of a friendly figure's special power.
design_note: Carrying wounds over makes his attack ramp the same clock that kills him, and the aura-immunity drawback is huge in a synergy army but nearly free in a solo build.

name: Ashmaw Pyreborn
ability_1_desc: Ashmaw Pyreborn do not start the game on the battlefield. When an Ashmaw Prowler you control is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die. If the destroyed Ashmaw Prowler was on a lava field, molten lava, or road space, add 3 to your die roll. If you roll a 14 or higher, place an Ashmaw Pyreborn figure on the space that Ashmaw Prowler occupied, if that space is unoccupied. You may never have more than 2 Ashmaw Pyreborn figures on the battlefield at one time. You may place Order Markers on this Army Card even if there are no Ashmaw Pyreborn figures on the battlefield.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with this Ashmaw Pyreborn, roll the 20-sided die once for each opponent's figure it moved adjacent to this turn. If you roll a 15 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Figures with the Lava Resistant or Lava Enhanced special power are not affected by Molten Wake.
ability_3_desc: This Ashmaw Pyreborn never rolls for molten lava damage or lava field damage and does not have to stop on molten lava spaces. This Ashmaw Pyreborn cannot roll defense dice while it is on a water space.
design_note: An Uncommon Hero add-on whose quantity, timing, and total value all hinge on a 35%-or-better d20 roll per base figure death, with terrain swinging the odds.

name: Ildrissa Stormsung
ability_1_desc: Ildrissa Stormsung does not start the game on the battlefield. If Ildrissa the Windcaller would be destroyed, instead of removing her Army Card from play, remove her figure from the battlefield and place Ildrissa Stormsung on the space Ildrissa the Windcaller occupied. Ildrissa Stormsung is placed with no Wound Markers. Move any unrevealed Order Markers from Ildrissa the Windcaller's Army Card to this Army Card. If Ildrissa Stormsung cannot be placed on that space, place her on the closest empty space she can occupy.
ability_2_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. Choose a figure within 4 clear sight spaces of Ildrissa Stormsung. That figure and all figures adjacent to it are affected by Galewind Special Attack. Roll each attack separately. Figures adjacent to the chosen figure roll no more than 2 dice for defense against Galewind Special Attack.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Ildrissa Stormsung's movement, ignore elevations. Ildrissa Stormsung may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Ildrissa Stormsung starts to fly, if she is engaged she will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: The card is a guaranteed second life with upgraded stats and carries over unrevealed Order Markers, so its value depends entirely on how cheap and survivable the base hero is.

name: Grimjaw the Unchained
ability_1_desc: Grimjaw the Unchained does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing an Order Marker on Grimjaw Ironhide's Army Card and before taking a turn with Grimjaw Ironhide, if Grimjaw Ironhide has 2 or more Wound Markers on his Army Card, you may remove Grimjaw Ironhide from the battlefield and place Grimjaw the Unchained on that space with 2 Wound Markers. Take a turn with Grimjaw the Unchained instead. For the rest of the game, Order Markers may be placed on this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with Grimjaw the Unchained, you may attack one additional time with Grimjaw the Unchained. The second attack must be against an adjacent figure. Grimjaw the Unchained rolls no more than 4 dice for the second attack.
ability_3_desc: At the end of a turn in which Grimjaw the Unchained did not inflict at least one wound, Grimjaw the Unchained receives 1 wound. If an opponent's figure adjacent to Grimjaw the Unchained attacks with a normal attack, it must attack Grimjaw the Unchained if it is able.
ability_4_desc: Grimjaw the Unchained may add 3 to his Move number as long as he is unengaged prior to moving. Grimjaw the Unchained must be able to move adjacent to an opponent's figure in order to use Unchained Charge.
design_note: Enormous offense on defense 2 is paired with self-wounding and forced targeting, so the drawbacks may either cancel the upgrade or accelerate it depending on the opponent's army.

name: Vek-Tal Siege Chassis
ability_1_desc: Vek-Tal Siege Chassis does not start the game on the battlefield. Before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on Vek-Tal Mark I's Army Card to remove Vek-Tal Mark I from the battlefield and place Vek-Tal Siege Chassis on that space. Place on this Army Card the same number of Wound Markers that were on Vek-Tal Mark I's Army Card, up to a maximum of 3. For the rest of the game, Order Markers may be placed on this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: On any turn with Vek-Tal Siege Chassis, it may either move or attack, but not both. Vek-Tal Siege Chassis is never moved, placed, or affected by any opponent's special power that would move it.
ability_3_desc: Range 8. Attack 3. Vek-Tal Siege Chassis cannot use Pulverizer Cannon Special Attack on a turn in which it moved. Choose a space within 8 clear sight spaces. All figures on or adjacent to that space are affected by Pulverizer Cannon Special Attack. Roll each attack separately.
ability_4_desc: All friendly Soulborgs adjacent to Vek-Tal Siege Chassis add 1 to their defense dice.
design_note: A move-or-attack restriction on a range 8 area special attack makes it swing wildly between a dominant gun platform and a wasted Order Marker depending on map size.

name: Thistlewick in Full Bloom
ability_1_desc: Thistlewick in Full Bloom does not start the game on the battlefield. After revealing an Order Marker on Thistlewick the Seedling's Army Card, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, remove Thistlewick the Seedling from the battlefield and place Thistlewick in Full Bloom on that space with the same number of Wound Markers, then take a turn with Thistlewick in Full Bloom. If you roll a 12 or lower, take a turn with Thistlewick the Seedling as normal. For the rest of the game, Order Markers may be placed on this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: After moving and before attacking with Thistlewick in Full Bloom, you may choose one friendly figure adjacent to Thistlewick in Full Bloom. Remove 1 Wound Marker from the chosen figure's Army Card. You may not use Sapling Mending on Thistlewick in Full Bloom.
ability_3_desc: An opponent's small or medium figure may not move out of a space adjacent to Thistlewick in Full Bloom unless you roll the 20-sided die for that figure and roll an 11 or higher. Roll separately for each figure as it attempts to leave. A figure that fails may take no further movement that turn.
ability_4_desc: Thistlewick in Full Bloom may move through spaces occupied by friendly Elves and Sprites without becoming engaged and without stopping.
design_note: A d20 gate on the transformation, free healing, and a soft-lock zoning power make this a support piece whose price hinges on how often the swap actually fires.

name: Shades of Nokthara
ability_1_desc: Shades of Nokthara do not start the game on the battlefield. When Nokthara the Sealed is destroyed, place all 3 Shades of Nokthara on the space Nokthara the Sealed occupied and on empty spaces adjacent to that space. Any unrevealed Order Markers on Nokthara the Sealed's Army Card are moved to this Army Card. Any Shade that cannot be placed is removed from the game.
ability_2_desc: If a Shade of Nokthara inflicts one or more wounds on an opponent's Unique Hero with a normal attack, you may remove 1 Wound Marker from any one Undead Army Card you control.
ability_3_desc: Shades of Nokthara are never attacked when leaving an engagement. Shades of Nokthara may move through spaces occupied by opponent's figures without becoming engaged, but may not end their movement on an occupied space.
ability_4_desc: When counting spaces for Shades of Nokthara's movement, ignore elevations. Shades of Nokthara may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Shade of Nokthara starts to fly, if it is engaged it will not take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Three highly mobile attack 3 bodies appearing automatically on the base hero's death effectively refunds the hero, making the add-on cost hard to separate from the base card's own value.

name: Brannoch Roused
ability_1_desc: This Brannoch Roused does not start the game on the battlefield. Before revealing a numbered Order Marker, if a Brannoch Sentinel you control has 2 or more Wound Markers on its Army Card and occupies a rock, road, or rubble space, you may remove that Brannoch Sentinel from the battlefield and place this Brannoch Roused on that space with 2 Wound Markers. For the rest of the game, Order Markers may be placed on this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: If this Brannoch Roused moves 3 or more spaces on its turn, it cannot attack that turn.
ability_3_desc: When this Brannoch Roused attacks an adjacent small or medium figure with a normal attack and that figure receives at least one wound, you may move the defending figure 1 space directly away from this Brannoch Roused. If the defending figure cannot be moved, it receives 1 additional wound.
ability_4_desc: This Brannoch Roused adds 2 to its Defense Value when defending against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure while it occupies a rock space.
design_note: An uncommon hero that must be paid for on top of already-purchased Sentinels, then punished for moving, creates real tension between strong defensive stats and terrain dependence.

name: Marshal Aurelia, Standard Raised
ability_1_desc: Marshal Aurelia, Standard Raised does not start the game on the battlefield. Before revealing a numbered Order Marker, you may reveal the "X" Order Marker on Marshal Aurelia of Kandora's Army Card to remove her from the battlefield and place Marshal Aurelia, Standard Raised on that space with the same number of Wound Markers. For the rest of the game, Order Markers may be placed on this Army Card.
ability_2_desc: All friendly Soldiers within 4 clear sight spaces of Marshal Aurelia, Standard Raised add 1 to their Attack Value when attacking an adjacent figure. Marshal Aurelia, Standard Raised is not affected by Rallying Standard Aura 4.
ability_3_desc: When Marshal Aurelia, Standard Raised would receive one or more wounds from a normal attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, ignore 1 of those wounds.
ability_4_desc: Before taking a turn with Marshal Aurelia, Standard Raised, you may first take a turn with any Squad of Soldiers you control who follow Einar.
design_note: A faction-wide attack aura plus bonding plus a wound-negating d20 is priced as an add-on, so the swap cost has to account for value the base card already provides.

name: Emberkin Gruts
ability_1_desc: Emberkin Gruts do not start the game on the battlefield. Whenever a Kindle Grut you control is destroyed, you may place 1 Emberkin Grut from this Army Card on the space that figure occupied or on any empty lava field or molten rock space within 3 spaces of that figure. You may never have more than 4 Emberkin Gruts on the battlefield at one time.
ability_2_desc: Emberkin Gruts never roll the 20-sided die for lava field spaces or molten lava spaces, and they are never affected by Lava Field or Molten Lava damage. Emberkin Gruts add 1 to their Attack Value while occupying a lava field or molten rock space.
ability_3_desc: When an Emberkin Grut is destroyed, before removing the figure, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, each figure adjacent to that Emberkin Grut receives 1 wound. Emberkin Gruts are never affected by Flare Out.
ability_4_desc: Emberkin Gruts are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Weak base stats hide a recursion engine and a 50% chance of area damage every time a figure dies, so value scales unpredictably with figure count and terrain.

name: Vexil the Kindler
design_note: placeholder

name: Ashira Flamesong
ability_1_desc: Range 4 + Special. Attack 5. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Conflagration Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. After resolving Conflagration Special Attack, Ashira Flamesong receives 1 wound.
ability_2_desc: Ashira Flamesong may not roll more than 1 defense die against any attack, even if a power or aura would add defense dice to her defense roll.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Ashira Flamesong's movement, ignore elevations. Ashira may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Ashira is engaged when she starts to fly, she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: A 6-attack flyer with only 2 life and a hard defense cap whose best power wounds her, so her damage ceiling and her survival floor pull the price in opposite directions.

name: Kelda-9 Longshot
ability_1_desc: If you did not move Kelda-9 Longshot before attacking this turn, add 1 to Kelda-9's Attack Value for her normal attack. If Kelda-9 moved at least 1 space this turn, subtract 2 from her Attack Value for her normal attack.
ability_2_desc: When Kelda-9 Longshot attacks a figure that is not adjacent to her with a normal attack, the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
ability_3_desc: When Kelda-9 Longshot is attacked by a figure that is 4 or fewer spaces away from her, she rolls no defense dice.
design_note: Range 9 with an effective attack of 6 and defense-stripping is elite artillery, but the sniper only functions standing still and dies to anything that closes within four spaces.

name: Sarpedon Mortarmen
ability_1_desc: Range 8 + Special. Attack 4. A Sarpedon Mortarman may use Mortar Barrage Special Attack only if it did not move this turn. Choose an empty space or a figure within 8 spaces of the attacking Mortarman; you do not need clear line of sight to the chosen space. All figures on the chosen space and all spaces adjacent to it are affected by Mortar Barrage Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: Before rolling attack dice for Mortar Barrage Special Attack, if another Sarpedon Mortarman you control has clear line of sight to the chosen space, add 1 die to the attack roll.
ability_3_desc: After a Sarpedon Mortarman attacks with Mortar Barrage Special Attack, that figure may not attack again this round, even if an Order Marker is revealed on this card.
design_note: Indirect-fire area damage that ignores line of sight is enormously strong on any map, but the no-move requirement, 1 defense, and once-per-round reload cap its actual output.

name: Sythris the Bile Adept
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 4. Figures roll 1 fewer defense die when defending against Corrosive Spit Special Attack. If Corrosive Spit Special Attack inflicts at least 1 wound on a Hero, that Hero's controlling player must subtract 1 from that Hero's Defense Value for the rest of the game.
ability_2_desc: When Sythris the Bile Adept is attacked by an adjacent figure, Sythris rolls no defense dice.
ability_3_desc: Instead of moving normally with Sythris the Bile Adept, you may place Sythris on any empty space within 4 spaces of a Marro figure you control, if that space is not more than 1 level higher than the space Sythris is leaving.
design_note: A permanent stacking defense debuff on enemy Heroes is a unique long-game threat, yet the figure is a two-life target that cannot defend itself in melee at all.

name: Crypt Shrikes
ability_1_desc: If a Crypt Shrike moved at least 4 spaces this turn before attacking, add 1 die to that Crypt Shrike's attack roll for its normal attack.
ability_2_desc: Each time a Crypt Shrike destroys an opponent's figure, you may remove 1 Wound Marker from any Unique Undead Hero you control.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Crypt Shrikes' movement, ignore elevations. Crypt Shrikes may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Crypt Shrike starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Three flying figures throwing six attack dice each can delete a Hero in one turn, but any single hit removes a figure and the card offers no protection whatsoever.

name: Tessaly Voltaic
ability_1_desc: Range 7. Attack 4. After resolving this attack, if the defending figure was not destroyed, you may choose one figure adjacent to the defending figure and attack it with Arc Lance Special Attack with an Attack Value of 2. You may not choose the same figure more than once with Arc Lance Special Attack in the same turn.
ability_2_desc: Before rolling attack dice for Arc Lance Special Attack, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 11 or higher, add 2 dice to that attack roll. If you roll a 10 or lower, Tessaly Voltaic receives 1 wound before attack dice are rolled.
ability_3_desc: Tessaly Voltaic never rolls for lava field damage or molten lava damage, and she is never affected by an opponent's special attack that targets more than one figure.
design_note: Immunity to multi-target special attacks plus a chaining range-7 attack that can reach 6 dice is priced awkwardly against a body that dies to two normal hits and can wound itself.

name: Thornbow Skirmisher
ability_1_desc: When attacking with a Thornbow Skirmisher, add 1 die to the attack roll for each other Thornbow Skirmisher you control that has already attacked that same defending figure this round.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with a Thornbow Skirmisher, if that Thornbow Skirmisher is not engaged, you may move it up to 2 spaces. A Thornbow Skirmisher may not use Fade Into the Wood to move onto or over a space occupied by a figure.
ability_3_desc: A Thornbow Skirmisher may add 1 to its Defense Value while it occupies a space adjacent to a tree, ruin, or jungle piece.
design_note: A one-life common Hero is nearly free individually, but stacking several of them turns Volley Fire into 6-plus dice at range 7 with hit-and-run repositioning.

name: Blastcap Goblins
ability_1_desc: Range 1 + Special. Attack 6. Choose an adjacent figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure, other than Blastcap Goblins, are also affected by Blastcap Detonation Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. After resolving Blastcap Detonation Special Attack, destroy the attacking Blastcap Goblin.
ability_2_desc: When a Blastcap Goblin you control is destroyed by an opponent's normal attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, each figure adjacent to that Blastcap Goblin receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: If a Blastcap Goblin you control begins its turn within 6 spaces of an opponent's figure, that Blastcap Goblin must end its movement as close as possible to the nearest opponent's figure.
ability_4_desc: Blastcap Goblins may climb up or down any number of levels of terrain in a single space of movement.
design_note: A squad whose figures trade themselves for a 6-dice area blast is either a devastating tempo weapon or dead weight depending on whether the forced-charge drawback lets it reach anything.

name: Quintus Farbeam
ability_1_desc: Range 9. Attack 5. Quintus Farbeam cannot move and attack with Sniper Rifle Special Attack on the same turn. If the defending figure is at Range 6 or greater, that figure rolls 2 fewer defense dice.
ability_2_desc: If a figure receives at least 1 wound from Quintus Farbeam's Sniper Rifle Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 16 or higher, remove 1 unrevealed Order Marker at random from that figure's Army Card.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack, if Quintus Farbeam did not move on his most recent turn, he rolls 1 fewer defense die.
design_note: A 5-die, range-9 defense-stripping shot is one of the deadliest attacks in the game, but it is locked behind no-move-and-attack and a power that can reduce him to zero defense dice.

name: Ember Wisps
ability_1_desc: After an Ember Wisp attacks, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll an 8 or lower, destroy that Ember Wisp.
ability_2_desc: When an Ember Wisp is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die for each figure that was adjacent to it. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound. Elemental figures are never affected by Cinder Burst.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for an Ember Wisp's movement, ignore elevations. An Ember Wisp may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When an Ember Wisp starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Attack 5 flying squad figures are enormous offense, but a 40% self-destruct chance per attack and a retaliatory death burst make the card's real damage output and trade math very hard to model.

name: Gravemarrow Slingers
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 4. A Gravemarrow Slinger that moved this turn may not attack with Bone Shard Barrage Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: At the end of each round, if one or more Gravemarrow Slingers you control were destroyed during that round, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, place 1 previously destroyed Gravemarrow Slinger on an empty space adjacent to a Gravemarrow Slinger you control. If you control no Gravemarrow Slingers, place it on any empty space within 4 spaces of your starting zone.
ability_3_desc: Gravemarrow Slingers cannot attack on a turn in which they were placed by Reassemble 15.
design_note: Four attack dice at range 6 across three figures is premium ranged firepower, but the total price swings on whether the no-move clause or the slow trickle of revivals dominates.

name: Chrysalid Bursters
ability_1_desc: When a Chrysalid Burster attacks, add 1 to its Attack Value for each other Chrysalid Burster you control that is adjacent to that Chrysalid Burster.
ability_2_desc: Instead of moving and attacking with a Chrysalid Burster, you may destroy that Chrysalid Burster. If you do, each figure adjacent to it receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: On a turn you take with the Chrysalid Bursters, each Chrysalid Burster that is able to move must end its movement as close as possible to the nearest enemy figure, counting clear spaces.
design_note: Stacked attack values up to 7 and guaranteed wounds from Rupture are extreme burst, but forced movement toward the enemy strips all positional control from a defense-1 squad.

name: Thaelen Voltmage
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 5. After attacking with Chain Lightning Special Attack, if the defending figure received at least 1 wound, you may choose another figure within 3 clear sight spaces of that figure and attack it with Chain Lightning Special Attack with 2 fewer attack dice. You may continue to chain in this way, subtracting 2 attack dice each time. No figure may be attacked more than once per turn with Chain Lightning Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: If this Thaelen Voltmage rolls no skulls when attacking with Chain Lightning Special Attack, this Thaelen Voltmage receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: If this Thaelen Voltmage does not attack on his turn, he may move up to 3 additional spaces.
design_note: Chaining 5, 3, and 1 dice through a clustered squad can wipe a whole card in one order marker, yet 2 life plus self-wounding whiffs means he may never attack twice.

name: Ashigaru Hoka
