ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 4. When attacking with Fire Bomb Special Attack, choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the chosen figure are also affected by Fire Bomb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: After an Ashigaru Hoka attacks with Fire Bomb Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1, 2, or 3, destroy that Ashigaru Hoka.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for an Ashigaru Hoka, if it is adjacent to another Ashigaru figure you control, add 1 automatic shield to the defense roll.
design_note: A cheap common hero that throws a 4-dice area attack is the most efficient damage-per-point in the format if it survives, so the 15% self-destruct and 1 life must carry the entire discount.

name: Sylvane Greenlash
ability_1_desc: Sylvane Greenlash cannot move and attack on the same turn.
ability_2_desc: When Sylvane Greenlash attacks a figure at Range 5 or greater, the defending figure cannot roll more than 3 defense dice against that attack.
ability_3_desc: If Sylvane Greenlash is attacked while adjacent to a tree, a bush, or a Dryan figure you control, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 13 or higher, Sylvane Greenlash takes no damage from that attack.
design_note: Range 8, attack 5, and a defense cap gut high-defense heroes from across the map, but the value hinges almost entirely on how often terrain lets the 40% dodge apply to a 2-life body.

name: Zephyra Duskwing
ability_1_desc: When Zephyra Duskwing attacks, she may attack one or two times.
ability_2_desc: If Zephyra Duskwing moved at least 4 spaces on her turn, add 2 dice to her first attack that turn.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for Zephyra Duskwing's movement, ignore elevations. Zephyra Duskwing may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Zephyra Duskwing starts to fly, if she is engaged she will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Flying in for 5 dice then 3 dice is assassin-grade output, but 2 life and 1 defense mean a single squad attack in return usually ends her, making her price a pure risk-premium judgment.

name: Cassia Veil
ability_1_desc: When Cassia Veil attacks a figure with a normal attack from more than 5 clear sight spaces away, the defending figure rolls 2 fewer defense dice.
ability_2_desc: After attacking with Cassia Veil, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 12 or higher, you may move Cassia Veil up to 3 spaces. She may not end this movement adjacent to an enemy figure, and she takes any leaving engagement attacks as normal.
ability_3_desc: When Cassia Veil rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, she rolls 2 fewer defense dice.
design_note: Range 9 with attack 5 and defense-stripping is among the best ranged output in the game, but 2 life and effectively zero defense when engaged means a single reached turn removes her.

name: Vector-Null
ability_1_desc: Range 9. Attack 6. Vector-Null cannot move and use the Siege Battery Special Attack on the same turn. Figures who are not adjacent to Vector-Null roll 1 fewer defense die when defending against the Siege Battery Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with Vector-Null in which it used the Siege Battery Special Attack, roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 1-5, Vector-Null receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: If Vector-Null did not move on its most recent turn, add 1 to its Defense Value until the end of your next turn.
design_note: A 6-dice range 9 barrage that pierces cover is enormous damage, but the no-move restriction, self-wound roll, and 2 life make it a static target that can be charged or sniped off a hill.

name: Skylance Ascendants
ability_1_desc: If a Skylance Ascendant moves at least 3 spaces this turn and begins its move at a height at least 4 levels above the base of the figure it attacks, add 1 die to its normal attack and the defending figure rolls 1 fewer defense die.
ability_2_desc: When a Skylance Ascendant rolls defense dice against a normal attack from a figure who is not adjacent, it rolls no defense dice.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for a Skylance Ascendant's movement, ignore elevations. Skylance Ascendants may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Skylance Ascendant starts to fly, if it is engaged it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Three flying figures swinging 6 attack dice with defense reduction is squad-wiping melee output, but any ranged army erases them with undefended hits before they land.

name: Vor'Kesh the Bloodsinger
ability_1_desc: Before attacking with Vor'Kesh, you may inflict 1 wound on Vor'Kesh to add 3 dice to his attack for that attack only. You may not use Blood Price if it would destroy Vor'Kesh.
ability_2_desc: After Vor'Kesh destroys one or more opponent's figures on his turn, you may move Vor'Kesh up to 4 spaces. He takes any leaving engagement attacks as normal.
ability_3_desc: Vor'Kesh rolls no defense dice against Special Attacks.
design_note: A 9-dice swing plus chain movement can behead a hero line in one order marker, but he only survives about two hits and folds instantly to any special attack.

name: Fulgor Mantids
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 5. Only one Fulgor Mantid may use the Galvanic Burst Special Attack each turn. After resolving the Galvanic Burst Special Attack, the attacking Fulgor Mantid is destroyed.
ability_2_desc: Instead of moving normally with a Fulgor Mantid, you may place that Fulgor Mantid on any empty space adjacent to another Fulgor Mantid you control within 4 spaces of it. If it is engaged when it starts to relay, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_3_desc: When counting spaces for a Fulgor Mantid's movement, it may move down any number of levels without stopping and never takes falling damage.
design_note: Each figure converts itself into one guaranteed 5-dice ranged strike, so the card's value depends entirely on whether trading a figure per turn for 2.5 expected damage is efficient at common-squad pricing.

name: Tindermask Bombardier
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 4. Choose a figure to attack. All figures adjacent to the targeted figure are also affected by the Firebomb Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each affected figure rolls defense dice separately. If a Tindermask Bombardier is within 2 clear sight spaces of the targeted figure, that Bombardier is also affected by the Firebomb Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: When a Tindermask Bombardier is destroyed, roll the 20-sided die for each figure adjacent to it. If you roll an 11 or higher, that figure receives 1 wound.
ability_3_desc: A Tindermask Bombardier cannot move and use the Firebomb Special Attack on the same turn unless it begins its turn on a road space.
design_note: Common heroes are normally cheap, but a stackable multi-target 4-dice blast with a death explosion gives one-life figures disproportionate board impact.

name: Cinderhusk Revenant
ability_1_desc: When this Cinderhusk Revenant is destroyed, each figure adjacent to it receives 1 wound. Figures adjacent to this Cinderhusk Revenant that are immune to fire damage are not affected by Combusting End.
ability_2_desc: If an opponent's figure moves out of a space adjacent to this Cinderhusk Revenant, after that figure's move you may move this Cinderhusk Revenant up to 2 spaces. It may only end this movement on an empty space adjacent to an enemy figure.
ability_3_desc: This Cinderhusk Revenant cannot be healed, and cannot receive more than 1 wound from any single attack.
design_note: One life with attack 6, an unavoidable death burst, and a hard cap of 1 wound per attack means its survivability is set entirely by how many separate attack rolls an opponent can make each round.

name: Sergeant Halden Roe
ability_1_desc: Sergeant Halden Roe is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: A completely vanilla 5-life 4/4 melee hero whose single defensive-mobility power gives almost nothing to hang extra points on, so it defines the baseline curve.

name: Bruni Stonehand
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Bruni Stonehand's movement, double the height of each level he climbs.
design_note: High defense paired with low move and attack makes him a grinder whose worth depends entirely on how much terrain-climbing mobility is valued.

name: Kiro Windblade
ability_1_desc: Range 5. Attack 3. Kiro Windblade may not use the Javelin Volley Special Attack on a figure he is engaged with.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for Kiro Windblade's movement, ignore elevations. Kiro Windblade may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When Kiro Windblade starts to fly, if he is engaged, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Flying plus a ranged 3-dice special attack turns a mediocre melee stat line into a flexible skirmisher, and the overlap between the two powers is easy to over- or under-price.

name: Vex-7 Rail Sentry
ability_1_desc: Range 6. Attack 3. When a Vex-7 Rail Sentry attacks with the Rail Pulse Special Attack, it may not move on the same turn.
design_note: A cheap common hero whose special attack outranges its normal attack but forbids moving, so the drawback and the upgrade nearly cancel and the card sits awkwardly on the low end of the scale.

name: Thornhide Boar Riders
ability_1_desc: Thornhide Boar Riders are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Fast, fragile melee commons with squad-wide Disengage: the power is standard but unusually potent on a 3-figure high-move squad, blurring the 40-80 melee squad band.

name: Legionnaires of Ostia
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. Any or all Legionnaires of Ostia may use the Pilum Special Attack. A Legionnaire of Ostia may not use the Pilum Special Attack on a figure it is engaged with.
design_note: A weak melee squad carrying a stronger short-range special attack straddles the melee and ranged squad price bands depending on how often players can keep the legionnaires unengaged.

name: Pinion Scouts
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Pinion Scouts' movement, ignore elevations. Pinion Scouts may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. When a Pinion Scout starts to fly, if it is engaged, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
design_note: Defense 4 flying commons with only attack 2 are pure map-control screens, so their value comes from survivability and height-grabbing rather than damage output.

name: Gorb the Bruiser
ability_1_desc: When this Gorb the Bruiser attacks, it may attack one additional time.
ability_2_desc: When counting spaces for this Gorb the Bruiser's movement, double the height of each level it climbs.
design_note: Double Attack on a large 5-life body with no offsetting drawback pushes an otherwise plain bruiser toward triple-digit territory, and the uncommon-hero stacking makes the per-card cost sensitive.

name: Sir Aldric Thorne
ability_1_desc: Sir Aldric Thorne is never attacked when he leaves an engagement.
ability_2_desc: Sir Aldric Thorne adds 1 to his Defense Value when attacked with a normal attack by an adjacent figure.
design_note: A plain 4-life melee knight whose only powers are defensive conveniences, so he must be priced almost entirely off raw stats.

name: Spearmen of Vale Harbor
ability_1_desc: Spearmen of Vale Harbor are never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_2_desc: When a Spearman of Vale Harbor that has not moved this turn rolls defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, add 1 die to his defense.
design_note: A baseline 3/3 melee common squad whose only extras are a free-exit power and a conditional defense die, so it defines the low end of the melee squad band.

name: Corvus Ashglade
ability_1_desc: Range 8. Attack 3. Corvus Ashglade may not move and use Longarrow Special Attack in the same turn.
ability_2_desc: Corvus Ashglade may move through and over all tree and jungle pieces as though they were empty spaces of the same level, and he is never attacked when leaving an engagement with a figure that is adjacent to a tree or jungle piece.
design_note: His special attack trades the whole move for three extra range, making it unclear how much the extended reach is actually worth over his ordinary Range 5 attack.

name: Grukka Pitclimber
ability_1_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Grukka Pitclimber may double his Height.
ability_2_desc: When Grukka Pitclimber attacks a figure whose base is at least 3 levels below his base, add 1 die to his attack.
design_note: A cheap common hero whose value swings entirely on how much terrain-dependent climbing and a situational bonus die matter.

name: Wind Lancers of Sumara
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for a Wind Lancer of Sumara's movement, ignore elevations. A Wind Lancer may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Wind Lancer of Sumara is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If a Wind Lancer of Sumara moves at least 4 spaces this turn before attacking, add 1 die to its attack for that attack.
design_note: Flying plus a charge bonus die on an Attack 3 / Defense 2 common squad sits right between the cheap melee squads and the premium flyers.

name: Borrik Emberfell
ability_1_desc: Range 4. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to the figure targeted by Blast Keg Special Attack are also affected by Blast Keg Special Attack. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately. Borrik Emberfell is never affected by his own Blast Keg Special Attack.
ability_2_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Borrik Emberfell may double his Height.
design_note: A tanky hero with a ranged area special attack but only Move 4, so mobility drag partly offsets the strong offense.

name: Crossbowmen of Kelvic Watch
ability_1_desc: When a Crossbowman of Kelvic Watch that has not moved this turn attacks a non-adjacent figure, add 1 die to his attack.
ability_2_desc: After taking a turn with the Crossbowmen of Kelvic Watch, you may choose one unengaged Crossbowman of Kelvic Watch you control who did not attack this turn and roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 15 or higher, that Crossbowman may attack one figure within 6 clear sight spaces.
design_note: Range 6 with a conditional third die approximates an Attack 3 shooter but only when standing still, and the 30% d20 extra shot is hard to weigh.

name: Grendok the Cudgel
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Grendok the Cudgel may attack any or all figures adjacent to him with Sweeping Blow Special Attack. Roll each attack separately.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from a non-adjacent figure, Grendok the Cudgel adds 1 automatic shield to whatever is rolled.
design_note: Six life with a multi-target melee special attack and passive ranged resistance stacks three ordinary bonuses that together may exceed a plain statline's price.

name: Skreel Duskwing
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Skreel Duskwing's movement, ignore elevations. Skreel Duskwing may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Skreel Duskwing is engaged when he starts to fly, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: Skreel Duskwing is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Flying and Disengage together grant near-total mobility on a fragile 2-life common hero, so the powers are worth more than the statline suggests.

name: Sir Tovan Marek
ability_1_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. All figures adjacent to Sir Tovan Marek are affected by Broad Sweep Special Attack, even figures you are not engaged with. Roll attack dice once for all affected figures. Each figure rolls defense dice separately.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, Sir Tovan Marek adds 1 die to his defense.
design_note: A plain 5-life, 4/4 melee hero whose only question is how much a mandatory-but-harmless 3-dice sweep and a single bonus defense die are worth on a slow Move 4 chassis.

name: Krogar Flintjaw
ability_1_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Krogar Flintjaw may double his Height.
ability_2_desc: Krogar Flintjaw is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
design_note: Cheap common hero with high attack but only 2 life and 2 defense, so its price hinges on whether Climb x2 plus Disengage make it a repeatable harasser or just a one-hit screen.

name: Marksmen of Fenhollow
ability_1_desc: When a Marksman of Fenhollow attacks a figure whose base is at least 2 levels below the attacking Marksman's base, add 1 die to that attack.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice against a normal attack from an adjacent figure, a Marksman of Fenhollow adds 1 die to his defense.
design_note: A three-figure Range 6, Attack 2 common squad whose value swings entirely on how often players can secure the 2-level height bonus that turns it into an Attack 3 line.

name: Skyclaw Harriers
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for a Skyclaw Harrier's movement, ignore elevations. A Skyclaw Harrier may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If a Skyclaw Harrier is engaged when it starts to fly, it will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: If a Skyclaw Harrier moved at least 4 spaces this turn, add 1 die to its attack.
design_note: Three flying Attack 3 melee figures with a conditional fourth die are easy to overrate, since Defense 2 and 1 life make them die to any return fire.

name: Zephra Vane
ability_1_desc: Zephra Vane is never attacked when leaving an engagement.
ability_2_desc: When rolling defense dice for Zephra Vane, if she is adjacent to a tree or bush, add 1 die to her defense.
ability_3_desc: Zephra Vane does not have to stop her movement when she enters a space adjacent to a tree or bush occupied by an enemy figure's engagement; she may move through spaces containing bushes without any movement penalty.
design_note: A clean Range 5 / Attack 3 skirmisher hero whose price depends on how much terrain-dependent defense and total engagement freedom are worth versus a flat statline.

name: Rotgrave Shamblers
ability_1_desc: When moving up or down levels of terrain, Rotgrave Shamblers may double their Height.
ability_2_desc: If a Rotgrave Shambler you control begins its move unengaged, you may add 1 to its Move number. A Rotgrave Shambler using Relentless Shamble must end its movement adjacent to an enemy figure if it is able to do so.
ability_3_desc: After a Rotgrave Shambler you control receives a wound from a normal attack from an adjacent figure, you may roll the 20-sided die. If you roll a 17 or higher, the attacking figure receives one wound.
design_note: Four slow Attack 3 / Defense 3 bodies with a forced-advance rider and a 20% retaliation trigger sit awkwardly between cheap chaff and a real front line.

name: Vaelthris the Cliffwing
ability_1_desc: When counting spaces for Vaelthris the Cliffwing's movement, ignore elevations. Vaelthris may fly over water without stopping, pass over figures without becoming engaged, and fly over obstacles such as ruins. If Vaelthris is engaged when he starts to fly, he will take any leaving engagement attacks.
ability_2_desc: Range 1. Attack 3. Choose an adjacent figure to attack. If that figure receives one or more wounds from Rending Talons Special Attack, Vaelthris may immediately attack a second adjacent figure with Rending Talons Special Attack. Vaelthris may not attack the same figure more than once each turn with Rending Talons Special Attack.
ability_3_desc: When rolling defense dice for Vaelthris the Cliffwing against a normal attack from a figure whose base is at least 1 level below Vaelthris's base, add 1 die to his defense.
design_note: A Move 7 flier with Attack 5 plus a chaining 3-dice special attack could easily be priced like a small dragon even though it only has 5 life and Defense 3.
